name: Vampire
description: Vampires are undead, fanged creatures that drink the blood of the living.

features.name: Fangs
features.text: Make a **Strength Roll** to bite a target within Melee range, dealing **d8** physical damage using your Proficiency.

features.name: Feed
features.text: On a successful Fangs attack against a living creature, you can also **mark a Stress** to Feed. Place a number of tokens on this card equal to the number of Hit Points your target marks. You can hold up to **5 tokens** at a time. Spend a token before an action roll to make your Fear Die a **d20** instead. When you take a Long Rest, remove a token. If there are no tokens on this card, all your action and reaction rolls are made with disadvantage.

questions: How did you become a vampire? Were you turned by another vampire, or did you seek out this transformation?
What do you miss most about your mortal life?
How do you manage your hunger around your companions?

name: Werewolf
description: Werewolves are creatures who transform into supernatural wolves.

features.name: Wolf Form
features.text: When you mark one or more Hit Points, you can also **mark a Stress** to enter your Wolf Form. While in this form, gain a **d10** Wolf Die that you add to all attack and damage rolls. When you would gain a Hope while in Wolf Form, you mark a Stress instead.

transformation.name: Wolf Form
transformation.trigger: Mark Hit Points + mark a Stress

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: When you mark your last Stress while in Wolf Form, you go into a Frenzy. Roll a number of **d20s** equal to your tier and automatically deal that much physical damage to all creatures within Very Close range. Then drop out of Wolf Form.

questions: How did you contract lycanthropy? Was it a curse, a bite, or something else?
What is your relationship with the moon? Does it affect your transformation?
How do your companions feel about your wolf form?

name: Reanimated
description: Reanimated are corpses who have been brought back to life.

features.name: Stitch Up
features.text: During a rest, you can only clear Hit Points if you have access to remains from a recently deceased creature. Describe how using this material affects your appearance. You cannot clear Hit Points by any means except a downtime move or the Risk It All death move.

features.name: Corpse
features.text: When you Risk It All on a death move, if you fail, you can permanently **mark a Hit Point** to succeed instead. When you do, you still use the Hope Die's value to clear Hit Points and Stress.

questions: How did you die, and who or what brought you back?
What parts of your body are clearly not original? How do you feel about them?
Do you remember your death? How does that memory affect you?

name: Shapeshifter
description: Shapeshifters are creatures that can change their physical form.

features.name: Change Shape
features.text: During a long rest, you can spend a downtime move to swap your current ancestry with another. When you do, describe how your appearance changes.

features.name: Only Skin Deep
features.text: When you Change Shape, you only gain the benefit of one of the ancestry's features, which you select when you choose the ancestry. You can spend a downtime move to switch which of your ancestry's features you gain the benefit of.

questions: What is your true form, if you have one? Or have you always been a shapeshifter?
What ancestry do you find yourself shifting into most often? Why?
How do your companions recognize you when you change forms?

name: Ghost
description: Ghosts are spirits trapped between the mortal realm and the veil of death.

features.name: Spirit Form
features.text: Your physical form can shift between corporeal and incorporeal. **Mark a Stress** to transition into and out of your Spirit Form. While in Spirit Form, you can move through solid objects, are immune to physical damage, and take double magic damage. You can **spend 2 Hope** to attack or physically interact with the material world.

transformation.name: Spirit Form
transformation.bonus: Move through objects, immune to physical damage
transformation.drawback: Double magic damage, spend 2 Hope to attack/interact

features.name: Ephemeral
features.text: Cross out a Hit Point slot when you take this card and when you increase your tier. When you mark your last Hit Point, you must choose Blaze of Glory as your death move.

questions: How did you die, and what unfinished business keeps you tethered to the mortal realm?
What does it feel like to shift between corporeal and incorporeal forms?
Can the living see you when you're in your Spirit Form?

name: Demigod
description: Demigods are creatures whose veins flow with the blood of the gods.

features.name: Ichor of the Gods
features.text: Your advantage die is always a **d10** instead of a d6.

features.name: Weight of Divinity
features.text: When you roll a failure with Fear, you must **mark a Stress** or give the GM an additional Fear.

questions: Which god are you descended from? What domain do they represent?
How does your divine heritage manifest physically?
What expectations does your divine parent have of you?
